justification: Inspected javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel/BinaryExprMetaModel.java, javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel/JavaParserMetaModel.java, and javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/expr/BinaryExpr.java. Repository search found only two external references to this class: JavaParserMetaModel creates the single static instance `binaryExprMetaModel`, and BinaryExpr returns that instance from `getMetaModel()`. The class itself is a small generated leaf: it only extends ExpressionMetaModel, imports BinaryExpr and Optional, and declares three PropertyMetaModel fields. This is low fan-in/low fan-out, not a dependency hub.
